Results.ReviewText: The last grill you will need to buy - Why? its a Smoker, Grill and a heck of a good time.  Easy to assemble - easy to use.  Webber has outdone themselves with this one.
Results.Title: WEBBER HAS DONE IT AGAIN

Results.ReviewText: I purchased  this grill for a replacement for my old one of 20 years.  When i wad putting it together I found 3/8" paint chip on the bowl. The new one is far superior  than rhe old. I like the ash bin and the thermometer in the lid.. the new grill is great and alot more adatable. Only cooked  2 " ribeye steaks on it  using both direct and indirect and the steaks came out great.
Results.Title: Great Warranty  and great grill

Results.ReviewText: the lid to the grill is not attached, you have a way to open and hold the lid open but it would be much better if the lid was attached
Results.Title: Lid on Grill

ClientResponses.Response: Hi John, thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are sorry to hear about the damage to your new grill and the delay with receiving your order. We will contact you shortly to assist via email. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Results.ReviewText:
An excellent charcoal grill except mine came damaged and obviously in the manufacturing process.
Reached out to Weber for warranty claim but haven't heard back in weeks. Still have the damaged lid and functions ok, however you have to adjust to get it on. 
Come on Weber how long does it take to get resolves? Weeks Months?
Results.Title: Good news bad news

Results.ReviewText: Love it! It wasn’t hard to put together and we use it all the time!
Results.Title: Love it!

Results.ReviewText: The grill is great though when we bought it it was missing a part we haven’t been able to find anywhere’s. But the Grill is amazing we grill 5 days a week!
Results.Title: Missing Part Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: Weber is definitely the best grill made. The fact that it is made in the USA is a important to me when I was shopping for a new grill.
Results.Title: Best grill made hands down.

Results.ReviewText: The Weber Master-Touch 22" grille is simply the best.  Very well made, well thought-out design and a pleasure to use.  The added features on the Master-Touch such as the removable ash bin,  lid holder and multi-function grate are fantastic - they really up the game when it comes to grilling.  My prior charcoal grille was a Weber and lasted over 15 years of regular seasonal use - I expect this one will perform in a similar manner.
Results.Title: Huge Weber Fan!!

Results.ReviewText: Fantastic grill. I love the lid holding feature and ash catch/cleaner: Everything works great. Much better than the standard $30-$40 “Walmart” charcoal grill I’m used to. It’s absolutely worth the money.
Results.Title: Worth the upgrade from the cheap charcoal grill.

Results.ReviewText: To be careful when lifting and replacing the grill lid
Results.Title: Master-Touch charcoal grill 22”

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback! We appreciate you bringing this up to our attention! Please know that a generous warranty backs your grill, and we are to help. We will pass your feedback to the appropriate team. We are glad that our support team could assist with placing your order. Please, if you have any questions or concerns, be sure to let us know at support@weberstephen.com or 1-800-446-1071. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Results.ReviewText: The removable center piece to the grilling grate makes it harder to clean and gets in the way of scooping burgers with a scapula sometimes. The two tool hooks on the handle are actually awkwardly shaped (too wide) so most tools can't fit on there and I had to buy a separate kettle grill tool hanger. Just after two cooks, I've noticed the cover is scuffing from placing it on the cover holder.  All that being said, I do love the ash catcher pot. And I enjoy that the top vent handle is plastic so I can safely adjust the vent with my bare hands. But was it worth the price? I don't think so but others will disagree and I might change my mind if this grill lasts me over 10 years. Also, the triangle leg support came bent but customer service is very good and they sent me a replacement free of charge.
Results.Title: Worth the price?

Results.ReviewText: I have had a 22” Weber grill for the last 40 years. This is my third one! I have cooked my turkey in one for Thanksgiving every year and loved it.
Results.Title: Try cooking a turkey in this Weber.

Results.ReviewText: This grill is awesome. Easy to control the heat. Ash disposal is a breeze. Would recommend to anyone who loves to grill.
Results.Title: Weber 22” Master Touch Charcoal Grill

Results.ReviewText: My old Weber kettle actually never died. I had it for 15 years. My kid bought a house and we took it there to a house warming cook-out.  He wanted it so much that I decided to leave it there and get a new one.  I love my new Master Touch! Construction is as good as ever. The charcoal baskets, the ash catcher and the rest of the new features are a great improvement.  Of course, it cooks like a Weber so you know the quality is there.
Results.Title: Love my new kettle.

Results.ReviewText: We ordered this one because the newer Weber we got from a big box depot had a warped lid and leaked heat and smoke around the lip.  This unit has a better build and new features the other doesn’t.  The blue enamel color is beautiful, and the lid stand and thermometer are a great help. The grip on the lid vent saves me finger burns too!
Results.Title: Master Touch 22”

Results.ReviewText: Love this grill, the only think is the grill grate should be heavier stainless steel.
Results.Title: My grill

Results.ReviewText: Great for grilling and smoking Love the charcoal flavor in the food
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Both my Son in Laws are fighting over who gets to grill on it . Now they both want one . It’s Awesome. Love the Blue Color Too
Results.Title: My New Grill

Results.ReviewText: I am beginner on cooking with a charcoal grill and this is awesome product. It’s really easy to maintain and food made over this grill tastes really good.
Results.Title: Great product

Results.ReviewText: Best grill made!  Easy to maintain temperature on this grill
Results.Title: Awesome grill

Results.ReviewText: We really like our new 22" Master-Touch Weber charcoal grill. Along with our 18" Weber, there’s now enough room for cooking a feast of meats and vegetables,  direct and indirect  heating, as required! Excellent product!
Results.Title: 22" Master-Touch Weber Charcoal Grill EXCELLENT!

Results.ReviewText: The best grill ever used. easy to clean, baskets are useful. This grill meet all the expectations for our family.
Results.Title: Don't waste money and time with other options.

Results.ReviewText: Love it easier too cook so many different foods easier
Results.Title: Master touch grill

Results.ReviewText: Easy to use! I love the part that holds the ashes. Easy clean up!!
Results.Title: Weber Master Touch 22" Charcoal Grill

Results.ReviewText: Great Grill for smoking as well as just grilling!!! 1st time Charcoal griller and it's so easy to use. Removable ash can along with the movable blades that move back and forth easily make clean up easy. Highly recommend !
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: Best grill you could ever own.would recommend to anyone looking for great grills and good food
Results.Title: Best grill ever .

Results.ReviewText: The Best Grilling, Smoking all around entertainment equipment money can buy.
Results.Title: Masterpiece

ClientResponses.Response: Hello, thank you for taking the time to share your feedback! We are sorry to hear about the disappointment with your new Master-Touch! This is not the type of quality that we expect. Your feedback is greatly appreciated, and we will surely pass your feedback along to the appropriate team.  Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Results.ReviewText: Cheap parts and hardware only good for temporary use. Standard to keep you buying new grills.
Results.Title: Poor quality

Results.ReviewText: Easy to put assemble and easy to use. The cover storage is a great feature.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: Great for grilling, generates high heat that can be well-controlled with top and bottom vents.  The only negative for me is that my top does not fit the bottom well, so that I need to twist the top to find the sweet spot where it fits the bottom the best.
Results.Title: Great for Grilling, But My Top Fits Poorly

Results.ReviewText: J'adore les produits et services de weber! ........
Results.Title: Excellent produit

Results.ReviewText: This is a great grill! I've used it for normal grilling, low and slow, and smoking foods. It holds temperature pretty consistent for those longer cooks, too. The only reason I won't give it 5 stars is the legs. They are extremely thin and flimsy, and almost feel like plastic. Luckily I don't plan on putting a lot of heavy food on the grill so they should hold up, but for $230 I really expected more.
Results.Title: Good grill, but the legs are flimsy

14510601.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14510601.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate fits circular GBS grillware· Included Char-Rails make it easy to arrange charcoal· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Tuck-Away Lid Holder provides handy space to hang lid· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels.· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant and 2” taller· 10-year limited warranty
